assessment.guidance: Judge the final work yourself. Packaging checks are not quality scores.

prompt: make a static webapp showing a 3d interactive snow globe showing a scene with a snow-capped peak

settings.thinkingBudgetBasis: CLI/model default; no explicit token budget

artifact.note: Single self-contained index.html: a canvas 2D software 3D renderer (perspective projection, painter's-algorithm depth sort, per-face lighting + distance fog) draws a faceted snow-capped peak with two secondary summits, an undulating snowfield, a frozen tarn and snow-dusted conifers placed on the analytic terrain height. 270 snow particles simulate gravity, drag, swirl and sphere/terrain collisions; they render in two depth passes so flakes behind the mountain are occluded. Interaction: drag to orbit (yaw + clamped pitch with inertia), flick or tap to shake (also Shake button and spacebar), wheel to zoom, auto-spin toggle and reset view. Glass shell is rendered with edge refraction darkening, sheen, specular highlights and rim; wooden pedestal with engraved plate and cast shadow. Verified logic by review (in-place transform safety, geometry inside globe radius, sorting/occlusion order, resize/DPR handling) and packaging via check: no external assets, no network, classic script, no storage.
